Spacious coastal living with elevated ocean views

Situated in the sought-after Long Island gated estate, this spacious 3-bedroom apartment offers comfortable coastal living in a secure 24-hour security estate, within walking distance of Thompson Bay.

The apartment features three generously sized bedrooms and two bathrooms, with the main bedroom enjoying an en-suite full bathroom with both bath and shower. The open-plan, fully fitted kitchen flows seamlessly into an exceptionally large living area comprising a combined lounge and dining room. Sliding doors open onto the outdoor area, where you can relax and enjoy the lovely elevated ocean views.

The property includes a lock-up automated garage plus an additional undercover parking bay. Residents enjoy access to a large communal swimming pool, while the estate is pet-friendly with BC permission.

Situated in the sought-after Long Island gated estate, this spacious 3-bedroom apartment offers comfortable coastal living in a secure 24-hour security estate, within walking distance of Thompson Bay.

The apartment features three generously sized bedrooms and two bathrooms, with the main bedroom enjoying an en-suite full bathroom with both bath and shower. The open-plan, fully fitted kitchen flows seamlessly into an exceptionally large living area comprising a combined lounge and dining room. Sliding doors open onto the outdoor area, where you can relax and enjoy the lovely elevated ocean views.

The property includes a lock-up automated garage plus an additional undercover parking bay. Residents enjoy access to a large communal swimming pool, while the estate is pet-friendly with BC permission.

A fantastic opportunity to own a spacious coastal home in one of Ballito’s popular beachfront areas — perfect as a permanent residence, holiday home or investment.
